card.name: Malay text before an "as" word
card.fires_on: Non-English text, mostly Malay (also Spanish and German), on a word or word ending just before a likely 'as/like' type word. Often partway through a word such as 'tul-is' or 'kepulau-an'.

modes.label: Malay word endings
modes.description: Pieces inside Malay words in sentences about books or the Malay archipelago.
modes.example: BUKU INI DI TUL<<IS>> PADA TAHUN 18

modes.label: Other foreign-language text
modes.description: Spanish or German words in links, references or labels.
modes.example: Advertencias: Venta bajo prescripción médica, mantengase fuera del alcance de los niños. No<< utilizar>> si el sello de seguridad del spray

card.writes: It pushes words meaning 'as' in other languages (comme, como, 作为, sebagai) and pushes down English 'as', 'to', 'in'.
card.plain: It fires on non-English text, mainly Malay, where a word meaning 'as' may come next.
